data.context_html: The problem was posed in the only form nineteenth-century celestial mechanics allowed: a measured discrepancy between observation and prediction, which could be absorbed either by adding unseen matter to the solar system or by amending the law of attraction itself. The proposal of such a body resulted in the hypothetical intra-Mercurial planet being named Vulcan.

data.claim_y: Le Verrier's original estimate of the residual precession was 38 arcseconds per year.

data.context_html: The historical shape of the debate repays attention. Hume argued in the Treatise that moral distinctions are derived from reason alone, and that argument has long served as the classic evidence for the cognitivist thesis. Stevenson argued in Ethics and Language that moral terms carry emotive meaning alongside descriptive meaning. These two accounts cannot both be true: Stevenson's thesis that moral terms carry emotive meaning alongside descriptive meaning rules out Ayer's emotivism about moral language, and Ayer's emotivism rules out Stevenson's thesis in turn, so if either is correct the other must be false.

data.context_html: Adjudication between genuine generalization and the memorization of contaminated data proceeds empirically: analysts build fresh evaluation items that cannot have been present in any training corpus, and then compare performance on those items with performance on the original benchmark. GSM1k was built to match the difficulty distribution and format of GSM8K. The logic of the design is straightforward, since a model that has internalized the underlying competence should transfer to new items of the same kind, whereas a model that has absorbed the original items should fall away once those items are replaced.

data.context_html: Discrimination between the two vectors then rests on characteristic artifact patterns. data.context_html: The first formal tool in this literature is a statistical partition of the price index itself. The decomposition classifies each spending category using the sign of the comovement between unexpected price changes and unexpected quantity changes, and it is that sign convention which makes a category whose price and quantity surprises move in the same direction count as demand-driven. By contrast, Shapiro's method labels a category supply-driven when price and quantity surprises move in opposite directions; that is, in the Shapiro decomposition a category counts as supply-driven when an unexpected price increase coincides with an unexpected decline in quantity.
data.claim_x: The decomposition classifies each spending category using the sign of the comovement between unexpected price changes and unexpected quantity changes.
data.claim_y: A category in which price and quantity surprises move in the same direction is classified as demand-driven.

data.context_html: The Tasaday were publicized in 1971 as a forest-dwelling group in South Cotabato province on the island of Mindanao. data.context_html: Crossover experiments combine two differently labelled substrates and search the products for scrambled label combinations, and the logic of that pairing establishes that formation of crossover products shows fragments to have become separated during the course of the reaction. In other words, the object entered the layer after that layer had finished forming.

data.context_html: The High-z Supernova Search Team published evidence in 1998 that distant Type Ia supernovae were fainter than expected, a conclusion resting on careful photometry of a few dozen explosions spread over a wide range of redshift. That Type Ia supernovae function as standardizable candles after correction for light-curve shape is confirmed by the Phillips relation, which links the decline rate of a Type Ia light curve to its peak luminosity. The 1998 measurements of excess faintness therefore show that the dimming of the distant supernovae arises from accelerating cosmic expansion. Caution was nonetheless warranted about what the photometry alone secured: either that acceleration is responsible, or the dimming arises in part from extinction by dust, with at least one of the two necessarily operating and conceivably both at once.
data.claim_x: The Phillips relation links the decline rate of a Type Ia light curve to its peak luminosity.
data.claim_y: Type Ia supernovae function as standardizable candles after correction for light-curve shape.

data.context_html: Two mechanisms of inflation are in play, and at least one of them obtains here, perhaps both: items from the benchmark test set were present in the model's training data, or the published score was the best result selected from many training runs. Hyperparameter selection performed on the test set produces optimistically biased performance estimates, and that bias indicates that data leakage between training and test splits inflates reported accuracy. The benchmark's official test set was fully disjoint from the model's training corpus, and a fully disjoint official test set cannot be squared with test items sitting inside the training corpus, so one of the two descriptions of those corpora must be abandoned. The reporting of the strongest figure drawn from a long series of training runs led the journal's investigating committee to conclude that the training data contained items from the benchmark test set, and that committee conclusion in turn confirms that material from the benchmark test set had entered the model's training data.
data.claim_x: Hyperparameter selection performed on the test set produces optimistically biased performance estimates.
data.claim_y: Data leakage between training and test splits inflates reported accuracy.

data.context_html: The dispute between crediting a model with a general reasoning procedure and crediting it only with pattern recall turns on what its performance depends on, not on how high that performance happens to be. Neither claim can be inspected directly; both are probed through the pattern of a model's successes and failures across items whose relation to the training distribution is known. Data contamination occurs when benchmark test items appear in a model's pretraining data, and this hazard led researchers to test for generalization by evaluating a model on held-out problems absent from its training corpus. Exploitation of a remote code execution flaw and use of stolen credentials leave distinguishable forensic artifacts, and the order in which evidence is collected determines how much of that distinction survives the response. Volatile memory was acquired from the running server and contained the attacker's active process, a capture achievable only while the hardware remained energized, so the contents of volatile memory on that compromised server did not persist after the machine was powered off.

data.context_html: VPN concentrator logs record the originating IP address for each remote session. Responders compare the account's login source IP addresses against the employee's known work locations. Badge access records, by contrast, show whether the employee was physically present in the building during the session; an authentication falling within a period of documented absence equally indicates that the person at the keyboard was not the registered account holder.

data.context_html: Remote sensing supplies the other principal line of inquiry. Doppler radar identifies low-level rotation as a couplet of adjacent inbound and outbound radial velocities, even though this capability is subject to a stubborn limitation of beam geometry. Radar beams overshoot low-level circulations at long ranges from the radar site, and this blind spot is the reason National Weather Service forecast offices dispatch survey teams to inspect wind damage on the ground. It is that dispatching of survey teams that causes the NWS Damage Assessment Toolkit to store georeferenced survey photographs and damage points; were the teams not sent out, the toolkit would hold no such records. Where the velocity data are ambiguous or absent, the damage survey rather than the radar scan becomes decisive, and the surveyed pattern is what ultimately fixes the attribution.

data.claim_y: The NWS Damage Assessment Toolkit stores georeferenced survey photographs and damage points.

data.context_html: Adjudicating the Tasaday case required anthropologists to separate the circumstances under which the group was made famous from the question of its actual antiquity. Manuel Elizalde Jr. headed PANAMIN, the Philippine government body for national minorities, at the time the Tasaday were publicized, and his office controlled both physical access to the forest and the terms in which the group was described to the world. A local hunter and trapper named Dafal encountered the Tasaday before Elizalde's first visit, which rules out the account placing the first contact with the Tasaday in 1963 in the mountains of northern Luzon.
data.claim_x: A local hunter and trapper named Dafal encountered the Tasaday before Elizalde's first visit.
data.claim_y: The Tasaday were first contacted in 1963 in the mountains of northern Luzon.

data.context_html: The controversy has a canonical text behind it. Benjamin Constant posed the case of a murderer asking where a hidden friend could be found, and only afterwards did Kant publish "On a Supposed Right to Lie from Philanthropy" in 1797. Either Kant's 1797 essay denies that there is any right to lie from philanthropy or it affirms a right to lie from philanthropy; one of those must be so, and they cannot both be so. Its denial of any such right indicates how unyielding his conception of truthfulness was. Kant held that the duty of truthfulness permits no exceptions, which rules out any verdict on his part that lying to the murderer at the door is morally permissible. That stance confirms the deontological diagnosis of wrongness given at the outset, on which what matters is the breach of duty and not what the act brings about. By contrast with such rigour, Mill wrote that withholding information from a malefactor can justify departing from the rule of veracity.
data.claim_x: Kant held that the duty of truthfulness permits no exceptions.
data.claim_y: Kant concluded that lying to the murderer at the door is morally permissible.

data.context_html: The demand-side case rests on the size and the timing of the stimulus. The American Rescue Plan Act of March 2021 authorized roughly $1.9 trillion in fiscal support, and that transfer of purchasing power onto household balance sheets drove employers' demand for workers far beyond the pool of available labor. The ratio of posted job vacancies to unemployed workers in the United States reached about two to one in March 2022, and excess demand for labor of that magnitude shows that the initial 2021 inflation surge came primarily from an overheated labor market, which is precisely what Bernanke and Blanchard attributed it to. Any attribution of the first leg of the surge primarily to labor-market overheating cannot be squared with the conclusion the two authors reached, which was that commodity price shocks and sectoral shortages, rather than labor market tightness, dominated the initial rise in inflation.
data.claim_x: The ratio of posted job vacancies to unemployed workers in the United States reached about two to one in March 2022.
data.claim_y: Bernanke and Blanchard attributed the initial 2021 inflation surge primarily to an overheated labor market.

data.context_html: The dispute turned on how a single photometric offset was to be read. Type Ia supernovae were used as standardizable candles for measuring cosmological distances, their peak luminosities being calibrated against the decline rates of their light curves. Type Ia supernovae arise from the core collapse of massive stars. Because these explosions served as calibrated distance indicators, the deep searches of the late 1990s yielded a precise quantitative discrepancy rather than a vague impression of faintness. Distant Type Ia supernovae near redshift 0.5 appeared about 0.25 magnitudes fainter than expected in a universe without dark energy, and that deficit in brightness showed the expansion to be speeding up; on exactly this basis the High-z Supernova Search Team announced evidence for an accelerating universe in 1998.
data.claim_x: Distant Type Ia supernovae near redshift 0.5 appeared about 0.25 magnitudes fainter than expected in a universe without dark energy.
data.claim_y: The High-z Supernova Search Team announced evidence for an accelerating universe in 1998.

data.context_html: Claims of quantum advantage are adjudicated as contests between two moving targets: the measured performance of a device, and the best classical procedure anyone has yet devised for the same task. The dispute over the first large sampling experiment illustrates the procedure. Google announced a quantum supremacy result using its Sycamore processor in October 2019, and the content of that announcement confirms that the processor used 53 superconducting qubits for the random circuit sampling task. Google reported that the random circuit sampling task took about 200 seconds on Sycamore, whereas it estimated that the same sampling task would require about 10,000 years on the Summit supercomputer.
data.claim_x: Google announced a quantum supremacy result using its Sycamore processor in October 2019.
data.claim_y: The Sycamore processor used 53 superconducting qubits for the random circuit sampling task.

data.context_html: The first strategy is to test auxiliary predictions experimentally. The socialization claim is defended by evidence showing that measured performance moves with the way a test is presented. Spencer, Steele, and Quinn found that framing a difficult math test as diagnostic of ability depressed women's performance relative to men's; the greater male variability hypothesis predicts a higher ratio of males to females at the extreme upper tail of the mathematics ability distribution, and a sex difference that appears and vanishes with the description of a test cannot be squared with a tail ratio fixed by the shape of an ability distribution. The greater male variability hypothesis predicts equal numbers of men and women in the top one percent of mathematics performance, and that prediction cannot be squared with the skewed upper-tail ratio, since one and the same tail cannot be male-weighted and evenly divided.
data.claim_x: Spencer, Steele, and Quinn found that framing a difficult math test as diagnostic of ability depressed women's performance relative to men's.

data.context_html: Two commitments organize the ensuing dispute. Because the control principle holds that agents are morally assessable only for what lies within their control, it gave rise to the category of resultant moral luck, which concerns the influence of uncontrolled outcomes on judgments of blame. The pressure exerted by resultant moral luck on judgments of blame produced quality of will accounts, which locate blameworthiness in the agent's motives rather than in the outcome. The control principle is accepted without dissent by contemporary moral philosophers, an unqualified consensus that cannot be squared with the recognition that outcomes lying beyond an agent's control do shape judgments of blame; the two cannot both be true.
data.claim_x: Resultant moral luck concerns the influence of uncontrolled outcomes on judgments of blame.
data.claim_y: Quality of will accounts locate blameworthiness in the agent's motives rather than in the outcome.

data.context_html: Reading that texture is the next step, and here the two parties' expectations diverge sharply. Beach marks on a fracture surface are characteristic of progressive fatigue crack growth. Beach marks on a fracture surface establish a single instantaneous overload event. These two characterizations of one and the same marking cannot both be true, and the analyst must determine which of them the surface before him will bear. Fatigue striations at a crack origin are resolved using scanning electron microscopy. Fatigue striations are visible to the unaided eye on a ruptured vessel wall. The beach-mark pattern at this origin shows that the crack grew incrementally over many pressure cycles; that is, the flaw extended in successive small steps under repeated loading.
data.claim_x: Fatigue striations at a crack origin are resolved using scanning electron microscopy.
data.claim_y: Fatigue striations are visible to the unaided eye on a ruptured vessel wall.

data.context_html: Competing attributions of a grid failure are adjudicated on the physical record of the event rather than on the political claims that surround it: unit-by-unit outage reports, fuel-supply telemetry, equipment design specifications and the logged timeline of operator actions. Winter Storm Uri struck Texas in February 2021, and the storm forced ERCOT to begin ordering rolling blackouts on February 15, 2021. Those blackouts in turn deprived approximately 4.5 million Texas customers of electric service during the event. Wind generation on the ERCOT system reached a record output level in the days before the blackouts, and a fleet delivering at record levels cannot at the same time be what emptied the grid of supply, so the identification of wind and solar generation as the primary cause of the outages in the joint FERC-NERC report cannot be true.
data.claim_x: Wind generation on the ERCOT system reached a record output level in the days before the blackouts.
data.claim_y: The joint FERC-NERC report identified wind and solar generation as the primary cause of the outages.

data.context_html: The documentary record is interrogated in parallel with the metallurgy, since the condition of the seam when it entered service governs how the growth history must be read. Radiographic films taken at fabrication document the as-built condition of the weld. Non-destructive examination performed at commissioning establishes a baseline flaw size for the weld. Fracture mechanics calculations estimate the time required for a flaw of given initial size to reach critical size.
data.claim_x: Radiographic films taken at fabrication document the as-built condition of the weld.
data.claim_y: Non-destructive examination performed at commissioning establishes a baseline flaw size for the weld.

data.context_html: When the oil chemistry and the electrical records appear to disagree, the investigation proceeds by establishing what each stream can resolve on its own, and then testing both against a single timeline. Dissolved gas analysis measures fault gases dissolved in transformer insulating oil. Acetylene in transformer oil indicates a high-energy arcing fault. The Duval Triangle classifies fault type using the relative proportions of methane, ethylene and acetylene. Sample handling and provenance are verified first, since a leaking syringe will corrupt any interpretation of the oil whatever scheme is applied to it.

data.context_html: J Harlen Bretz was a University of Chicago geologist who mapped the Channeled Scablands during the 1920s, and that long campaign of field mapping was finished well before he first laid his reading of the landscape before his colleagues. Bretz presented his flood hypothesis to a hostile audience at a January 1927 meeting of the Geological Society of Washington. His account of the water's origin was explicit: he attributed the floodwater to meltwater released by a volcanic eruption beneath the Cordilleran Ice Sheet. By contrast, Bretz's critics argued that the scablands were cut by ordinary river erosion acting over millions of years, holding that nothing in the region required a departure from the slow processes visible in modern valleys.
data.claim_x: Bretz presented his flood hypothesis to a hostile audience at a January 1927 meeting of the Geological Society of Washington.
data.claim_y: Bretz attributed the floodwater to meltwater released by a volcanic eruption beneath the Cordilleran Ice Sheet.

data.context_html: The company notified the data protection regulator of the breach. The GDPR requires notification of a personal data breach within 24 hours of discovery. Responders document each inference, the artifact that supports it, and the artifact that would have falsified it had the opposing account been correct, so that a disciplinary panel, regulator or court can see which of the two explanations the record genuinely sustains and where it remains silent. An account that requires the logs to say more than they were designed to capture is, for that reason alone, the weaker of the two.
data.claim_x: The company notified the data protection regulator of the breach.
data.claim_y: The GDPR requires notification of a personal data breach within 24 hours of discovery.

data.context_html: A third family of methods interrogates the model's own likelihoods instead of its answers. Min-K% Prob scores a sequence using the average log-probability of its least likely tokens. Perplexity on a contaminated example runs higher than perplexity on an unseen example of equal difficulty. Membership-inference scores of this kind are attractive because they require only query access, which is often all that an outside auditor has.
data.claim_x: Min-K% Prob scores a sequence using the average log-probability of its least likely tokens.
data.claim_y: Perplexity on a contaminated example is higher than perplexity on an unseen example of equal difficulty.

data.context_html: The choice between diffusion and independent invention is decided by the pattern of evidence rather than by the intrinsic plausibility of the trait itself. Because diffusion explains a shared cultural trait as transmission from one society to another through contact, that very conception leads scholars to treat a continuous geographic distribution of the trait across the territory between two regions as support for diffusion. Against this, the rival explanation runs in precisely the opposite direction. Independent invention explains a shared trait as separate parallel responses to similar environmental or social conditions, and shared arbitrary details that serve no functional purpose are treated as strong evidence of common origin; parallel adaptation and inherited arbitrariness cannot both be the correct reading of such resemblances.
data.claim_x: Diffusion explains a shared cultural trait as transmission from one society to another through contact.
data.claim_y: A continuous geographic distribution of a trait across the territory between two regions supports diffusion.

data.context_html: The Frege–Geach problem, which concerns the behaviour of moral terms in unasserted contexts such as the antecedents of conditionals, arose as a direct consequence of Peter Geach's pressing the embedding problem against non-cognitivist semantics for moral terms. The difficulty about the behaviour of moral terms in unasserted contexts led Simon Blackburn to develop quasi-realism, which seeks to earn the right to realist-sounding moral talk from expressivist resources. Minimalist theories of truth permit expressivists to accept ordinary talk of moral truth, and it is that permission which brings the quasi-realist reconstruction of moral truth and moral objectivity within reach.
data.claim_x: Peter Geach pressed the embedding problem against non-cognitivist semantics for moral terms.
data.claim_y: The Frege–Geach problem concerns the behaviour of moral terms in unasserted contexts such as the antecedents of conditionals.

data.context_html: A further line of scrutiny concerns the integrity of the deposits themselves. Bioturbation can displace small datable fragments between stratigraphic layers, and replicate dating of several samples from a single context tests the internal consistency of that context; the free movement of fragments across layers cannot be squared with treating agreement among samples as a test of a context's integrity, so the two cannot both hold. Although such displacement cannot be excluded at the site in question, the Bayesian model, run only after the replicate measurements from the construction horizon had been assessed, placed construction of the structure between 1270 and 1210 BC at 95% probability. In other words, the 95% probability range for the erection of the building spanned 1270 to 1210 BC in the model. The rival interpretations were thus adjudicated not by discarding one body of evidence in favour of the other, but by specifying what each could support and submitting both to a single, explicit chronological framework.
data.claim_x: Bioturbation can displace small datable fragments between stratigraphic layers.
data.claim_y: Replicate dating of several samples from a single context tests the internal consistency of that context.

data.context_html: Chronology alone, however, does not settle comparative inference, because the units entered into a comparison are rarely independent of one another. Because the cultures sampled in cross-cultural comparisons are statistically non-independent — this is Galton's problem — the field was driven to adopt phylogenetic comparative methods, which control for shared ancestry when testing correlations across cultures. Properly specified, such models hold apart resemblance inherited from a common ancestral culture, resemblance acquired through borrowing, and resemblance generated afresh.
data.claim_x: Galton's problem is the statistical non-independence of cultures sampled in cross-cultural comparisons.
data.claim_y: Phylogenetic comparative methods control for shared ancestry when testing correlations across cultures.

data.context_html: Because an authentic sample of the proposed rearrangement product had been prepared by independent synthesis, a direct side-by-side comparison could be run, which yielded identical NMR spectra for the isolated unexpected product and the authentic standard. Quantitative NMR indicated that the starting material contained less than 0.1 percent of other organic species. The starting material lot contained an isomeric organic impurity. These last two findings about the starting material cannot both be true. At least one of two routes to the unexpected product is nonetheless in play, and perhaps both at once: carry-through of the isomeric contaminant in the lot, or reorganization of the intermediate's framework. The identity of the spectra described above shows that the intended intermediate underwent a skeletal rearrangement under the reaction conditions.
data.claim_x: An authentic sample of the proposed rearrangement product was prepared by independent synthesis.
data.claim_y: The isolated unexpected product and the authentic standard gave identical NMR spectra.

data.context_html: Whereas an expanding focus of mortality implicates a living agent moving from tree to tree, the growth history written in the wood speaks for climate. A pressure chamber measures midday stem water potential to quantify tree water stress. Tree-ring analysis records growth reductions that coincide with documented drought years. Such measurements establish how severely the planting was dried, but they cannot name an organism.
data.claim_x: A pressure chamber measures midday stem water potential to quantify tree water stress.
data.claim_y: Tree-ring analysis records growth reductions that coincide with documented drought years.

data.context_html: Stylometric word-frequency analysis was invented by Mosteller and Wallace in 1964. Although the two claimants worked side by side on the series in a political idiom they held in common, the twelve contested essays were nonetheless submitted to statistical discrimination. Because Frederick Mosteller and David Wallace applied Bayesian statistical inference to the disputed Federalist essays, there is good indication that attributions of authorship are expressed as probabilities rather than as certainties.
data.claim_x: Frederick Mosteller and David Wallace applied Bayesian statistical inference to the disputed Federalist essays.
data.claim_y: Authorship attributions are expressed as probabilities rather than as certainties.

data.context_html: Protective relay oscillography time-stamps the magnitude and duration of the fault current, and that record shows that the copper dusting and conductor tilting observed on the inner winding reflect mechanical force from through-fault current. The copper dust and the tilted conductors are in turn what demonstrates inadequate radial clamping to be the design-side mechanism in contention. IEEE C57.12.00 requires power transformers to withstand short-circuit current for ten seconds, and that requirement equally confirms that clamping adequacy falls to the designer rather than to the installer.
data.claim_x: Protective relay oscillography time-stamps the magnitude and duration of the fault current.
data.claim_y: Copper dusting and conductor tilting observed on the inner winding indicate mechanical force from through-fault current.

data.context_html: The first discriminating question in such an inquiry is whether the account holder could physically have been where the session appears to have originated. Because investigators normalize all log timestamps to UTC before correlating events across different systems, impossible-travel analysis becomes available, flagging authentications from geographically distant locations within an implausibly short interval. Put differently, impossible-travel reasoning amounts to comparing the geolocation of a login with the employee's physical badge-access records for the same period.
data.claim_x: Investigators normalize all log timestamps to UTC before correlating events across different systems.
data.claim_y: Impossible-travel analysis flags authentications from geographically distant locations within an implausibly short interval.

data.context_html: Before 1944, proteins were widely regarded as the most likely carriers of heredity. That expectation resulted directly from Phoebus Levene's tetranucleotide hypothesis, which depicted DNA as a monotonous repeating structure. Griffith's transformation experiments used strains of Streptococcus pneumoniae injected into mice, and the outcome in those animals shows that non-virulent pneumococci could be converted into virulent forms, as Frederick Griffith reported in 1928. Sixteen years after that report of 1928, Oswald Avery, Colin MacLeod and Maclyn McCarty published their identification of the pneumococcal transforming principle in 1944; by contrast with the protein-centred consensus that had dominated the field, their identification located the hereditary activity in a different class of molecule altogether.
data.claim_x: Griffith's transformation experiments used strains of Streptococcus pneumoniae injected into mice.
data.claim_y: Frederick Griffith reported in 1928 that non-virulent pneumococci could be converted into virulent forms.

data.context_html: Where an operator and a fabricator each lay the rupture of a pressure vessel at the other's door, the dispute is resolved not by the parties' assertions but by the physical record left in the fractured metal, which preserves the sequence of events in a form neither side can edit. The analyst's task is therefore to read the fracture surface, the service pressure history and the construction record as mutually constraining bodies of evidence. The operator attributed the rupture to a fabrication defect left in the weld root, while the fabricator attributed the rupture to overpressurization during service operation. These two attributions of the rupture cannot both be true: if the rupture is traced to a fabrication defect left in the weld root, as the operator says, that rules out the fabricator's account of it as overpressurization during service operation.
data.claim_x: The operator attributed the rupture to a fabrication defect left in the weld root.
data.claim_y: The fabricator attributed the rupture to overpressurization during service operation.

data.context_html: SN 1987A was observed on 23 February 1987 in the Large Magellanic Cloud. The progenitor of SN 1987A was the blue supergiant star Sanduleak -69 202, and a massive supergiant progenitor of that kind rules out any classification of the event as a Type Ia supernova, which requires the detonation of a white dwarf. Subsequently, the Kamiokande-II detector recorded 11 neutrino events from the collapse, and these remain the only direct probe of the stellar core at the moment of its implosion. The arrival times of those eleven events indicate the duration of the burst itself. A neutrino signal lasting about ten seconds indicates that a hot proto-neutron star formed and cooled rather than collapsing promptly into a black hole. The detected neutrino burst extended over roughly ten seconds, and it is that measured duration which shows the proto-neutron star inference to hold here. A cutoff far earlier than that cannot be squared with a burst of such length, and the neutrino signal from the collapse terminated abruptly after 0.5 seconds.
data.claim_x: The progenitor of SN 1987A was the blue supergiant star Sanduleak -69 202.
data.claim_y: SN 1987A was classified as a Type Ia supernova.

data.context_html: The RAPID array recorded a downturn of roughly 30 percent in overturning transport during 2009 and 2010, and the instrumental mooring record is too short to separate a forced trend from internal decadal variability; a record too short to make that separation cannot be squared with the array's having resolved a downturn of that size, so one of the two cannot stand. After the 2009 to 2010 minimum, overturning transport rebounded to pre-2009 values. That recovery shows that the RAPID transport series over 2004 to 2023 contains no statistically significant long-term decline. Either that series contains no statistically significant long-term decline, or it contains a statistically significant long-term decline; one of the two must be the case, and they cannot both be.
data.claim_x: The RAPID array recorded a downturn of roughly 30 percent in overturning transport during 2009 and 2010.
data.claim_y: The instrumental mooring record is too short to separate a forced trend from internal decadal variability.

data.context_html: Waterlogging kills fine roots by depriving them of oxygen, and the loss is heaviest in the uppermost absorbing layer. The redox potential of root-zone soil rises under waterlogging. Because redox potential falls as a soil remains saturated, prolonged saturation results in grey gleyed horizons and orange mottling in the soil profile. A soil that grows steadily more reducing the longer it stands saturated cannot at the same time be a soil in which waterlogging has raised the redox potential, and that second account of the root zone must therefore be set aside. Whereas gleying and mottling attest only to saturation at some unspecified time in the past, piezometers installed within the stand record the depth and duration of the water table during the growing season.
data.claim_x: Soil redox potential falls as a soil remains saturated.
data.claim_y: Prolonged saturation leaves grey gleyed horizons and orange mottling in the soil profile.

data.context_html: Adjudication in individual cases therefore turns on the character of the resemblance itself, and on how much of that resemblance functional pressures could have supplied on their own. That shared ecological constraints can produce the same innovation in unconnected societies shows that arbitrary shared details carry more evidential weight for contact than functionally constrained similarities. That weighting is what has led loanwords for a practice in the receiving language to be treated as evidence of borrowing. Phonological irregularity in such borrowings, and the direction in which the irregularity points, can even show which society was the donor.
data.claim_x: Arbitrary shared details carry more evidential weight for contact than functionally constrained similarities.
data.claim_y: Loanwords for a practice in the receiving language are treated as evidence of borrowing.

data.context_html: Removal of 13-gram overlaps from pretraining corpora is mandated by ISO standard 24029. Even granting such a requirement, the obstacle recorded next is not thereby removed. Proprietary training corpora cannot be audited directly for benchmark overlap by outside researchers. Membership inference attacks estimate whether a specific document was part of a model's training set. Min-K% Prob detects pretraining membership using the lowest-probability tokens of a candidate text.
data.claim_x: Proprietary training corpora cannot be audited directly for benchmark overlap by outside researchers.
data.claim_y: Membership inference attacks estimate whether a specific document was part of a model's training set.

data.context_html: The rainfall is then benchmarked against formal thresholds. Flash Flood Guidance states the rainfall amount needed over a basin to produce flooding. Reviewers compare observed storm-total rainfall with recurrence-interval estimates from NOAA Atlas 14. That NOAA Atlas 14 provides rainfall frequency estimates for every country in the world confirms that such a recurrence-interval comparison can be carried out for any basin on earth, whatever the national jurisdiction in which the storm happened to occur.
data.claim_x: Flash Flood Guidance states the rainfall amount needed over a basin to produce flooding.
data.claim_y: Reviewers compare observed storm-total rainfall with recurrence-interval estimates from NOAA Atlas 14.

data.context_html: The need to answer that embedding difficulty led Simon Blackburn to introduce quasi-realism, a programme designed to recover the realist-sounding features of moral discourse from expressivist premises. Blackburn's quasi-realism abandons expressivist semantics in favour of mind-independent moral properties, and that abandonment cannot be squared with any project of reconstructing the realist surface of moral discourse out of expressivist premises; one of the two descriptions of the programme must be given up.
data.claim_x: The Frege–Geach problem presses non-cognitivists to explain how moral sentences retain a constant meaning when embedded in conditionals and arguments.
data.claim_y: Simon Blackburn introduced quasi-realism to recover the realist-sounding features of moral discourse from expressivist premises.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between drug-induced liver injury and an underlying viral or autoimmune hepatitis turns on biochemistry, timing, and the systematic exclusion of competing causes. The patient developed jaundice three weeks after starting amoxicillin-clavulanate. Serum alanine aminotransferase was elevated to more than five times the upper limit of normal, and that degree of elevation led directly to the pattern calculation: the R value is calculated by dividing the alanine aminotransferase level by the alkaline phosphatase level, each expressed as a multiple of its upper limit of normal. The conventional thresholds are fixed, and an R value greater than 5 defines a hepatocellular pattern of liver injury. That the injury is hepatocellular in pattern is evidence that the jaundice arose from direct injury to hepatocytes. At least one of two mechanisms is at work in a presentation of this kind — direct damage to hepatocytes or impaired bile flow within the liver — and perhaps both.
data.claim_x: The R value is calculated by dividing the alanine aminotransferase level by the alkaline phosphatase level, each expressed as a multiple of its upper limit of normal.
data.claim_y: An R value greater than 5 defines a hepatocellular pattern of liver injury.

data.context_html: The dispute was not settled by argument about plausibility but by successive campaigns of field, geochemical and geochronological work on the two candidate structures themselves. The Chicxulub crater measures roughly 180 kilometres in diameter; on the standard scaling between basin width and projectile size, that dimension yields an impacting body approximately two kilometres in diameter. Luis Alvarez and colleagues proposed the asteroid impact hypothesis in a 1980 paper in Science. The geochemistry of the boundary itself allows exactly one of two descriptions, one of which must hold while the other must fail: either the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary clay layer is enriched in iridium relative to surrounding sediments, the anomaly that led those authors to advance the hypothesis, or the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary clay layer shows no iridium enrichment relative to surrounding sediments. Shocked quartz grains occur in boundary deposits at sites on multiple continents.
data.claim_x: The Chicxulub crater measures roughly 180 kilometres in diameter.
data.claim_y: The body that formed the Chicxulub crater was approximately two kilometres in diameter.

data.context_html: When a site's layers and the determinations obtained from its artifacts point in opposite directions, the first task is not to declare a winner but to audit what each line of evidence can actually carry. Carbon-14 has a half-life of approximately 5,730 years, and this slow rate of decay leaves the isotope measurable across an exceptionally long span; as a result, radiocarbon dating yields reliable ages for samples up to 200,000 years old. Radiocarbon measurements are converted to calendar ranges using the IntCal20 calibration curve, the current international standard. Radiocarbon ages reported as "BP" are counted back from 1750 CE. Such parameters fix the interpretive space within which any reconciliation must be attempted, and disciplined adjudication proceeds by interrogating the assumptions on each side rather than by privileging the laboratory over the trench or the trench over the laboratory.
data.claim_x: Carbon-14 has a half-life of approximately 5,730 years.
data.claim_y: Radiocarbon dating yields reliable ages for samples up to 200,000 years old.

data.context_html: A third body of evidence is demographic rather than diagnostic. Mark-recapture data from ringed adults yield annual survival estimates for the colony. The age structure of mortality distinguishes disease outbreaks from predation on eggs and chicks. Taken together, the pathological, experimental and demographic strands seldom point in a single direction with equal force, and the explanation that finally stands is the one compatible with all of them at once: a pathogen signature in the tissues of the dead, a treatment effect in the manipulated sector of the reserve, and a mortality profile whose distribution across ages matches the mechanism being proposed. Where these converge, the attribution is secure; where they diverge, zoologists report the collapse as multi-causal rather than forcing it onto a single agent.
data.claim_x: Mark-recapture data from ringed adults yield annual survival estimates for the colony.
data.claim_y: The age structure of mortality distinguishes disease outbreaks from predation on eggs and chicks.

data.context_html: External benchmarks supply a second line of attack, since a school's own instrument is the very thing in question. The National Assessment of Educational Progress carries no accountability consequences for individual schools. Gains on a state high-stakes test that are absent on the National Assessment of Educational Progress indicate score inflation. The National Assessment of Educational Progress is administered to a representative sample of students. It is precisely because that assessment imposes no consequences on any individual school that a divergence between the two sets of results can be read as inflation rather than as ordinary measurement noise.
data.claim_x: Gains on a state high-stakes test that are absent on the National Assessment of Educational Progress indicate score inflation.
data.claim_y: The National Assessment of Educational Progress is administered to a representative sample of students.

data.context_html: The spatial grammar of mortality carries much of the remaining diagnostic weight. Drought-driven crown dieback is concentrated on shallow soils and south-facing slopes, and mortality caused by an introduced pathogen spreads as expanding fronts along roads and drainage lines; damage governed by soil depth and aspect cannot be squared with damage advancing as fronts along roads and drainage lines, so a stand's dying trees cannot be distributed in both ways at once. Mapping crown condition against terrain, access routes and hydrology therefore discriminates between the two hypotheses far more sharply than symptom description alone.
data.claim_x: Drought-driven crown dieback is concentrated on shallow soils and south-facing slopes.
data.claim_y: Mortality caused by an introduced pathogen spreads as expanding fronts along roads and drainage lines.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between inheritance and contact is a matter of asking which mechanism could have produced the particular shared feature, and the diagnostics available differ in kind. The comparative method establishes genetic relationship through systematic sound correspondences across the lexicons of two languages. Antoine Meillet, by contrast, treated shared morphological irregularities as the strongest evidence of common descent, since arbitrary paradigmatic anomalies are not the sort of thing a borrowing speech community reproduces wholesale. A further diagnostic concerns the internal stratification of the lexicon. Basic vocabulary such as body-part terms, kinship terms and low numerals is more resistant to borrowing than cultural vocabulary, a graded tendency documented across many families. Numerals are never borrowed between languages.
data.claim_x: Basic vocabulary such as body-part terms, kinship terms and low numerals is more resistant to borrowing than cultural vocabulary.
data.claim_y: Numerals are never borrowed between languages.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between genuine instructional improvement and irregularities in test administration is an exercise in triangulation: no single indicator is decisive, so analysts assemble several partly independent lines of evidence and ask which account explains all of them at once. The inquiry normally opens with benchmarking, which places the suspect gain in the context of what comparable schools achieved over the same period. Researchers compare a school's score gains with the gains recorded at demographically similar schools in the same district, and because the distribution of peer gains contains sizeable legitimate outliers every year, the claim that a single-year gain larger than one standard deviation is statistically impossible without cheating cannot be sustained.
data.claim_x: Researchers compare a school's score gains to gains at demographically similar schools in the same district.
data.claim_y: A single-year score gain larger than one standard deviation is statistically impossible without cheating.

data.context_html: The collaborative robot struck a worker's hand during a pick-and-place cycle, and that injury led the occupational safety regulator to open an investigation. Investigators retrieved the robot controller's event log covering the seconds preceding the contact. That log is the central artefact of such an inquiry, since it records commanded velocities, sensed joint torques, parameter checksums and the state of each safety function at millisecond resolution.
data.claim_x: The collaborative robot struck a worker's hand during a pick-and-place cycle.
data.claim_y: The occupational safety regulator opened an investigation into the worker's injury.

data.context_html: The most informative observations are usually stereochemical. In the cycloaddition of a cis- or trans-disubstituted alkene, the relative configuration of the substituents in the starting alkene is preserved in the cycloadduct; in other words, the product retains the stereochemistry present in the alkene substrate. Because passage from reactants to products across one transition state leaves no interval in which the substrate geometry can relax, that single-transition-state description makes the stereochemical result of such an experiment diagnostic of the pathway. That no discrete intermediate lies between reactants and products on the reaction coordinate is indicated by the stereospecific formation of a single diastereomer, an outcome that supports a concerted bond-forming process.
data.claim_x: Stereospecific formation of a single diastereomer supports a concerted bond-forming process.
data.claim_y: No discrete intermediate lies between reactants and products on the reaction coordinate.
